exposure: microbial invasion of the amniotic cavity (MIAC)
cohort: Eighty women with singleton pregnancies complicated by preterm prelabor rupture of membranes (PPROM).
finding: Women with microbial invasion of the amniotic cavity (MIAC) or microbial-associated intra-amniotic inflammation (IAI) had higher CD11b concentrations in the amniotic fluid than women without these complications.
cross-section timing: At the time of preterm prelabor rupture of membranes (PPROM).
